head_coach.name: Sébastien Migné
head_coach.play_style_summary: Aggressive, high-pressing, and highly direct tactical style prioritizing vertical play, rapid transitions, and overloading the opposition box to force defensive errors.

key_players.name: Jean-Ricner Bellegarde
key_players.performance_stats: A highly creative Premier League midfielder for Wolves who acts as the primary link between midfield transition and direct attacking moves.

key_players.name: Danley Jean Jacques
key_players.performance_stats: Robust defensive anchor for Philadelphia Union with 29 international caps and 6 goals, serving as the core shield for the defense.

key_players.name: Frantzdy Pierrot
key_players.performance_stats: Clinical target man playing for Çaykur Rizespor with a prolific international record of 33 goals in 49 caps for the national team.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Sidelined due to a knee injury.
Declined call-up to represent Haiti at the World Cup, stating he felt it was unfair to players who fought through the qualifiers.
